name: engineer-companion
title: Engineer Companion
author: you
description: An engineer companion that follows you, auto-builds ghosts from chests, crafts what it is missing, roams near its buildings, finds the best ore patch, deploys blueprints (e.g. miners) on it, and builds a small automation science factory (3 science + 3 gear assemblers) and a transport belt assembler, fed with plates by hand. Building zones (science factories, belt factory...) can be given a blueprint (pasted string or from the cursor) which the Engineer then places, powers and builds instead of its own layout.
